owner_note.text: Voice Chat now releases the mic the instant you pause or turn it off (it used to stay open through the last upload, so the Android light stayed on), and each sentence goes out as soon as it ends instead of waiting for a pause. Not built: correcting an already-sent sentence in place. That needs a new Servex verb (session/amend); until then, if the final hears it differently, the early wording stays and the difference is logged. Details: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/upload.md
